Grade: PP2
Subject: LANGUAGE ACTIVITIES
Strand: Strand 1
Topic 1.3: Active LISTENING

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Active LISTENING under Strand 1. It is aligned with the Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development (KICD) CBC design.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Active LISTENING together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
